newsitem.title: USA: American Home unit gets FDA OK for Zosyn.
newsitem.headline: American Home unit gets FDA OK for Zosyn.

text.p: Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories said Thursday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has authorized it to market the intravenous antibiotic Zosyn in the Abbott Add-Vantage I.V. drug delivery system.

The American Home Products Corp unit said Zosyn combines piperacillin, a broad spectrum antibiotic, with tazobactam, a beta-lactamase inhibitor. Zosyn is used in about 4,000 hospitals in the United States.
The Abbott Add-Vantage drug delivery system is a proprietary I.V. admixture system used by more than 2,500 U.S. hospitals that reduces pharmacist mixing time and cuts drug waste, it said.
